verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents an AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using your logs, metrics, traces, errors and web events, and suggests hypotheses. It also offers in-product chat, natural-language log and chart queries, AI-based suggestions for Linear tickets, automated post-mortems and suggested-fix pull requests. Together these clearly deliver AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing-page claims (e.g., how the in-app chat surfaces insights).
